summary: MCP Inspector: unauthenticated proxy endpoints allow remote code execution
details: The proxy server of @modelcontextprotocol/inspector before 0.14.1 exposed endpoints without authentication or origin checks. A web page visited by the developer could reach the local proxy (for example through DNS rebinding) and make it launch commands over stdio. Version 0.14.1 added session-token authentication and origin validation. Upgrade to 0.14.1 or later and do not expose the inspector proxy to untrusted networks.

database_specific.source: Public CVE record; not independently reproduced by Verfy.
